tasks.short: Interpret patient evidence to diagnose a condition.

steps.what: Locate actual patient history, reports and test results in the clinical record
Read actual findings and assess their quality, timing and clinical relevance
Determine differential diagnosis, clinical conclusion and unresolved uncertainty
Record and check the actual diagnostic conclusion and qualifications
Save the final diagnostic entry

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} clinical-record views for actual result chronology and source links. Clinician reads findings, determines diagnosis and records the conclusion; no generated diagnosis or inferred clinical fact.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated navigation among actual reports and results.
tasks.still_hard: Interpreting ambiguous findings for the actual patient.
tasks.human_edge: Make and qualify a clinically responsible diagnosis.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native clinical-record result views reduce navigation without determining diagnoses.

assumptions: Boundary is evidence analysis and actual diagnosis entry. Clinical/laboratory producers supply patient ID, date, result, unit, method, source and status; clinician retrieves and manually resolves missing or conflicting records in s1. No free structured diagnostic summary or inferred pregnancy history.

Native first; existing views yield zero new saving. Provisional retrieval20 excludes evidence reading35 and diagnosis40. Existing entry field already sufficient; writing4 and save1 retained. Normal entry checking gates save without extra approval ceremony; shares unmeasured.
unknowns: Current result views and actual navigation burden
research_questions: Can native views expose source, timing and status without hiding conflicting findings?

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete checked final diagnostic entry

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional retrieval20 reduced25 percent saves5 minus0.5 upkeep=4.5; half eligible cases gives2. Reading35, diagnostic judgement40, entry4 and save1 unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collect and maintain patient histories and clinical records.

steps.what: Take the actual history and collect examination findings and patient corrections
Write the clinical history and findings in the clinical record

loop.purpose: Draft the actual collected clinical history
loop.input: clinician dictation of actual findings or permitted consultation capture
loop.output: draft note distinguishing patient report, examination and unknowns
loop.check: Clinician checks symptoms, chronology, negation, attribution, examination findings and omitted sensitive qualifications against actual encounter
loop.stop: No recording permission, missing source, unsupported fact or two failed checks requires manual documentation
loop.why_not_simpler: Native structured fields first; variable patient narrative needs bounded drafting

steps.what: Check the complete final patient note against the actual encounter
Commit the checked final patient note

tasks.design: Test native {OTHER} clinical-record fields and dictation before bounded note drafting. Use actual permitted encounter capture or clinician dictation, keep source attribution and unknowns, and require complete final-note checking before commit.
tasks.previous_blocker: Narrative documentation after actual history collection.
tasks.enabler_now: Clinician-validated draft notes from actual encounter content.
tasks.still_hard: Sensitive histories, negation and clinically important omissions.
tasks.human_edge: Elicit accurate history and correct the record with the patient.
tasks.altitude: Less narrative composition; clinical record responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Autoscriber drafts consultation notes for clinician validation and clinical-record integration; its capability does not establish this task's time saving.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual collection, note drafting and commit. Clinician elicits history and findings in s1. Capture producer is permitted encounter recording or the clinician's actual dictation in s2; dictation, source preparation and correction time remain within70 percent of s2. Existing results retain actual source identifiers; missing facts stay unknown. Manual entry is fallback, not a free transcript.

Native first; existing drafting configuration earns zero. Provisional collection60 and ordinary full-note QA10 unchanged; commit1 retained. No automated diagnosis or medication recommendation. Local privacy, consent, access and staff consultation require actual review before rollout. Shares not measured.
unknowns: Permitted capture and actual documentation share
research_questions: Can drafts preserve attribution, negation and sensitive patient corrections?

incremental.description: Audit note omissions and maintain capture permissions

approvals.approved_version: s3 complete checked final patient note

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional note29 reduced30 percent saves8.7 minus1 upkeep=7.7; half permitted eligible encounters gives3.35. Actual history60, full-note QA10 and commit1 unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Explain procedures, results and treatments to patients.

steps.what: Retrieve actual results, chosen treatment and relevant approved patient information
Explain actual findings and procedures, answer questions and discuss patient preferences
outputs: actual patient discussion and expressed choices

steps.what: Record and check the actual explanation, patient questions and expressed choices
inputs: actual patient discussion and expressed choices

steps.what: Save the actual discussion record

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} clinical-record links to actual results and current approved {DOCS} information. Keep personal explanation and documentation of actual questions and choices human; information retrieval never implies understanding or consent.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated navigation to actual results and approved explanations.
tasks.still_hard: Explaining uncertainty and supporting informed patient choices.
tasks.human_edge: Listen, adapt language and check actual understanding.
tasks.altitude: Less navigation; patient communication responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native clinical-record links can retrieve approved information without replacing personal explanation or establishing patient consent.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual patient explanation and its existing clinical record. Laboratory/clinical producers supply actual results; clinician supplies chosen treatment; information owner supplies approved version and topic. Clinician resolves missing or inapplicable material manually in s1, discusses it in s2 and records actual outcomes in s3. No automatic conversation transcript or invented consent.

Native first; already linked information earns zero saving. Shares provisional, unmeasured. Actual discussion80 and entry9 unchanged; native fields already suffice for this brief entry and save1 retained. No added record-approval ceremony.
unknowns: Actual navigation burden and approved-information links
research_questions: Do native links retrieve the right current information for actual results?

approvals.approved_version: s3 complete checked actual discussion record

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional retrieval10 reduced30 percent saves3 minus0.5 upkeep=2.5; half eligible explanations gives1. Actual discussion80, record9 and save1 unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prescribe or administer treatment and specialised care.

steps.what: Select actual treatment after assessing patient condition and preferences
Enter the selected prescription details in the clinical prescribing system
Review actual medication surveillance warnings and resolve relevant safety concerns
Check the complete final prescription, patient, dose, route and dispensing destination
Transmit the checked final prescription to the external pharmacy
Provide actual hands-on therapy or specialised clinical care
Record and check actual treatment provided and observed response
Save the actual care record

tasks.design: Configure native {OTHER} prescribing favourites to reuse administrative fields only after the clinician selects treatment. Existing medication surveillance, final prescription checking, actual care and outcome recording remain human; transmit and record commit have separate final-version gates.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated administrative order fields after actual treatment selection.
tasks.enabler_now: Native prescribing favourites and structured order fields.
tasks.still_hard: Patient-specific treatment safety and actual clinical response.
tasks.human_edge: Choose and deliver appropriate care and respond to complications.
tasks.altitude: Less repetitive order entry; prescribing and care responsibility unchanged.

evidence.claim: G-Standaard provides medication surveillance for interactions, contraindications, doses and duplicates; this supports existing checks, not automated prescribing or a new runtime saving.
Model knowledge: native prescribing favourites can reduce repeated order fields after clinician treatment selection.

assumptions: Boundary uses a provisional mix of prescribing and actual care; individual encounters need actual reweighting. Clinical producers supply actual history and allergies; clinician chooses drug or therapy, dose, route and duration in s1 and enters patient-specific details in s2. Missing medication context requires manual resolution. Existing rule warnings arise from the clinical system; their runtime earns zero labour saving.

Native first; existing favourites yield zero. Only repeated administrative entry19 reduces20 percent, no drug selection or safety-check time removed. Treatment40, warning review10, final QA9, care15, actual outcome entry5, send1 and save1 retained. Actual response recorded only after care, prescription transmission never implies administration.
unknowns: Actual prescribing/care mix and available order favourites
research_questions: Can favourites avoid stale dose or patient assumptions while reducing repeated fields?

approvals.approved_version: s4 complete checked final prescription, patient and dispensing destination
s7 complete checked actual care record

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Provisional order19 reduced20 percent saves3.8 minus0.5 upkeep=3.3; half eligible repeated orders gives1.4. Clinical choice40, surveillance10, final check9, care15, outcome5, send1 and save1 unchanged.
